newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tohoku Oil says no date set for repair of unit.
newsitem.headline: Tohoku Oil says no date set for repair of unit.

text.p: Tohoku Oil Co Ltd said on Wednesday it did not know when repairs would be finished at its 45,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) direct desulphurisation unit, which was damaged by a fire on Monday afternoon.

"There's no way to tell when we can get the unit back on line as local authorities are still conducting an investigation into the cause of the fire," said a spokesman for Tohoku Oil, which belongs to a refinery group led by Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd .

The desulphuriser, capable of cutting the sulphur content in heavy fuel oil to as low as 0.2 percent, was being tested and was due to start commercial operations shortly after the fire began at the firm's Sendai plant in northern Japan's Miyagi prefecture.

Any potential production losses will be covered by shipping oil products to the plant from other refineries in the group, such as Mitsubishi Oil's Mizushima plant and Kawasaki refinery, a Mitsubishi Oil spokesman said.
Operations at the other units at the plant, including a 100,000 bpd crude distillation unit, were not affected by the fire.
